summary: Apayao representative with 41 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant evidence is mainly co-authored: a universal senior social pension, senior discounts and Magna Carta, indigent job-applicant fee discounts and the national minimum wage; she authored a tax code amendment (HB05207).
caveat: Nearly all evidence is co-authorship, which does not prove endorsement of each provision. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored universal senior social pension and discounts (-2), national minimum wage (-2) and indigent job-applicant fee discounts (-2). No tax-side or privatization evidence.
